reproject_local_to_global: reproject a 3D point cloud from local camera coordinates to global world coordinates using a 4x4 pose matrix
project_tps_into_worldmap: project a batch of 4x4 trajectory pose matrices into 2D map cell coordinates for topdown visualization
planned_path2tps: convert a list of 2D planner path coordinates into 4x4 trajectory pose matrices with optional rotation
get_direction: compute the rotation angle needed to align an initial pose toward a final pose with configurable thresholds
habitat_goalpos_to_tp: convert a habitat goal position given as distance and azimuth into a 4x4 trajectory pose matrix
